people.name: Ahasuerus
people.line: Persian Emperor (probably Xerxes I); husband of Esther

people.name: Vashti
people.line: Queen of Persia, deposed by King Ahasuerus (Xerxes)

translations.web: Also Vashti the queen made a feast for the women in the royal house which belonged to King Ahasuerus.
translations.bsb: Queen Vashti also gave a banquet for the women in the royal palace of King Xerxes.
